description: CAP. duckdb is held below 2.x because the 2.0.0 release publishes a
NARROWER wheel matrix than the 1.5.6 currently pinned:
duckdb 1.5.6  ->  cp310 cp311 cp312 cp313 cp314
duckdb 2.0.0  ->  cp311 cp312
requires-python here is >=3.12,<3.14, so it admits 3.13 -- and 2.0.0
has no cp313 wheel. Taking it would mean either dropping to
>=3.12,<3.13 or building duckdb from its sdist (a full C++ build).
Renovate's PR #7 offered it as an ordinary major; it is not.
Curiously the 2.0.0.dev* prereleases DID ship cp313 and cp314, so the
stable 2.0.0 wheel matrix looks like an incomplete release build
rather than a deliberate drop. Worth re-checking on 2.0.1: if the
wheels come back, this cap can go.
Note also that dbt-duckdb's `md` extra pins duckdb==1.5.5, so
enabling that extra would conflict with the 1.5.6 pin here.
CAP. requires-python cannot move to 3.15: NO duckdb release publishes
cp315 wheels -- not 1.5.6, not 2.0.0, not any of the 100+ versions on
PyPI. duckdb ships binary wheels per Python ABI and has no cp315 build
yet, and it has no pure-Python fallback.
Renovate's PR #3 proposed >=3.12,<3.14 -> >=3.15,<3.16, which would
have left the project unresolvable except by compiling duckdb from
sdist. The same class of breakage as
oluies/tedsds-duckdb-postgres#14, where psycopg-binary had no cp315
wheels.
Lift this once duckdb publishes cp315.
